*Bench Persona, Fixture Lead*

## Summary
- Named the bad key: `parse_config` in `src/config.py` now reports which key it choked on, instead of raising a bare `KeyError`. Callers keep their signature.
- Left the loader alone; it already fails closed.

```mermaid
graph LR
  caller[caller] --> parse[parse_config]
  parse --> named[named key error]
```

- The error a person sees: ![after](https://evidence.example.com/workspaces/pr-99/after.png)
- `python3 -m pytest tests/test_config.py` -- `12 passed in 0.30s`
- Full log: [pytest run](https://evidence.example.com/workspaces/pr-99/run.txt)

## Mergeability
- Surface: infra / config loader
- User-facing behavior changed: No

Closes #98
